title: How Airlines Can Scale with Seagliders | Oneworld, Japan Airlines & Alaska Airlines
summary: At REGENT's Demo Day factory opening ceremony on Sept. 30, 2026, airline investors in REGENT discuss where Seagliders fit in their networks.
body_markdown: At REGENT's Demo Day factory opening ceremony on Sept. 30, 2026, airline investors in REGENT discuss where Seagliders fit in their networks. Moderated by Matt Ridley, Director of Sustainability and Innovation at oneworld Alliance, the panel features Ao Kaimo, Senior Principal at Japan Airlines Ventures, and Pasha Saleh, Head of Corporate Development at Alaska Airlines. They cover why their airlines invested, how coastal and island communities could benefit, and how Japan Airlines is working with REGENT, Lloyd's Register and MOL on Seaglider operations and certification in Japan.
